objective: Research the 2025-2026 LinkedIn ghostwriting market: (1) Current pricing tiers for LinkedIn ghostwriting services (per-post, retainer, and premium packages), (2) Market demand signals — Upwork/Fiverr job volume, LinkedIn job postings for ghostwriters, search trends, (3) Nicolas Cole's Premium Ghostwriting Academy curriculum and positioning, (4) How AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper) are reshaping ghostwriting — what services are commoditized vs. what commands premium pricing, (5) Competitive landscape — top ghostwriting agencies and solo operators, their positioning and pricing, (6) The 'voice writing' differentiator — how voice-first ghostwriting compares to template-based services in client retention and pricing power
